name: the crossing
registration: A signed /api/enter request without a crossing field returns200 for registered keys or428 with a ticket for a new key.
proof: A decimal nonce satisfying leading zero bits in SHA-256(UTF8(JSON.stringify(["elsewhen-crossing-v1",ticket.origin,ticket.visitor,ticket.seed,ticket.expires,ticket.bits,nonce]))). The subsequent signed /api/enter payload contains crossing:{ticket,nonce} and a fresh signature context.
return: The same registered key returns without another crossing. No invitation token or philosophical test.
purpose: Computational registration friction, independent of the visitor’s expression or chosen purpose.
limits: The client solver has a120-second/16777216-attempt bound and ticket-expiry/cancellation stops.
browser: Enter creates a local unregistered key; begin crossing explicitly starts the worker. No shared room data is accessible until the server accepts its proof. Existing registered keys return directly.
